name: EcoDefender
summary:
The planet needs you! In EcoDefender VR you step into the role of an eco-hero fighting against environmental pollution in a vibrant virtual world. Armed with a futuristic device that launches algae balls, your mission is to restore nature by purifying the air, shutting down toxic engines, and defeating enemies that spread CO₂.
